company.name: Canary Technologies
company.shortDescription: Canary Technologies provides a digital guest management platform for hotels streamlining check-in, messaging, payments, and upsells.
company.description: Canary Technologies develops software solutions for the hospitality industry, focusing on improving operational efficiency and enhancing guest interactions. The company offers tools that replace traditional paper-based processes, enabling hotels to manage reservations, payments, and guest communications online. By streamlining these workflows, Canary Technologies helps hotel staff save time and reduce errors. Additionally, the software provides analytics and insights that assist hotel management in making informed decisions. Overall, Canary Technologies aims to transform the hospitality experience through innovative digital solutions that cater to the needs of both guests and hotel operators.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for managing hotel guest interactions across arrival, in-stay engagement, and departure workflows. It helps hotels reduce administrative work, increase ancillary revenue, and improve guest service.
productsAndServices.name: Guest Management System

productsAndServices.description: An AI platform for automating hotel communications and service workflows across phone, SMS, email, and web chat. It supports guest inquiries, reservations, customer service, direct bookings, and operational automation.
productsAndServices.name: Canary AI

productsAndServices.description: A platform for hotel group and event sales teams to capture leads, manage contracting workflows, and collect customer payments. It supports digital sales operations and integrates with PMS and sales-and-catering systems.
productsAndServices.name: Sales & Catering Payments Hub

productsAndServices.description: A digital payment and authorization platform for hotels that replaces paper forms and manual card entry. It helps process payments, capture card-on-file authorizations, reduce fraud and chargebacks, and support PCI-compliant workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Secure Hotel Transactions

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,597,022 to $600,000,000, a 78.98x increase.
